graveyard-laborer.title: Graveyard Laborer
graveyard-laborer.role: Melee tier 1 (replaces the base Shambler look)
graveyard-laborer.attack: Melee claw swipe on contact. Same AI as today's Shambler.

fallen-militiaman.title: Fallen Militiaman
fallen-militiaman.attack: Melee punch combo on contact. A bit tougher than the Laborer.

rusted-watchman.title: Rusted Watchman
rusted-watchman.attack: Melee overhead swing. Armour: takes 25 % less damage from the front cone (90 deg).

gravebound-knight.title: Gravebound Knight
gravebound-knight.role: Melee tier 4 / elite, mini boss candidate (KAN-23)
gravebound-knight.attack: Two-hit combo with a lunge (1.5 m dash, 0.6 s ground warning). Knockback x0.3.

plague-bloater.title: Plague Bloater
plague-bloater.attack: Walks to the Knight. In 2 m range: 1.0 s swell + green ground circle (r 2.8 m), then it bursts: 25 % max HP damage in the circle and a toxic cloud (r 2.2 m, 6 s, 15 dps). A kill by bolts bursts it too, so other zombies can be caught.

bone-archer.title: Bone Archer
bone-archer.attack: Keeps 7-9 m distance (backs off when the Knight comes near). Aim 0.8 s with a thin red line, then one fast arrow (14 m/s, 10 % max HP). Every 3rd volley: 3-arrow fan (30 deg). Arrows stop on pillars/walls. No bow in the mesh: attach a simple bow prop to the left hand.

pyre-thrower.title: Pyre Thrower
pyre-thrower.attack: At 6-10 m: throws a fire pot in an arc (1.1 s flight) to where the Knight will be (lead aim). Landing circle (r 1.6 m) shows on the ground during the flight. Impact 12 % max HP + burning ground patch 3 s (8 dps). Pattern: single, single, then a 3-pot spread.

bile-spitter.title: Bile Spitter
bile-spitter.attack: At 5-8 m: 0.7 s wind-up (throat glows), spits a slow acid glob (7 m/s) that leaves an acid puddle (r 1.4 m, 5 s, 12 dps, slows the Knight 30 %). Max 3 puddles per spitter.

frenzied-ghoul.title: Frenzied Ghoul
frenzied-ghoul.attack: Sprints (4.2 m/s, faster than the horde, slower than the Knight 5 m/s). At 4-6 m: crouch 0.5 s + red lane, then leaps 5 m (hit 10 % max HP). After the leap it is stunned 0.8 s (punish window).

grave-brute.title: Grave Brute
grave-brute.role: Heavy elite (replaces the scaled-up Brute look)
grave-brute.attack: Ground slam: 0.9 s wind-up, then an expanding shockwave ring (inner r 0 to outer r 4.5 m over 0.6 s, ring width 0.8 m) the Knight must dash through or outrun. 18 % max HP. Knockback immune.
grave-brute.stats: HP 520, speed 1.25 m/s, 26 dps contact, XP 25 (elite)

hexbound-shaman.title: Hexbound Shaman
hexbound-shaman.attack: Keeps 8-11 m. Cast A (every 5 s): ring of 8 violet soul orbs fired outwards (slow, 5 m/s, gaps between orbs). Cast B (every 12 s): buffs zombies in 6 m (+30 % speed, violet tint, 5 s) or raises 2 Laborers. Teleports 6 m away when the Knight gets within 3 m (cooldown 6 s).

pyre-lord.title: The Pyre Lord
pyre-lord.attack: Phase 1: (a) fireball fan, 7 bolts in a 70 deg cone; (b) fire nova, ring of 16 fireballs from the body; (c) slam with a flame circle (r 4 m). Phase 2 (50 % HP): (d) rotating spiral, 2 arms of fireballs for 3 s (bullet hell, gaps to walk through); (e) meteor rain, 6 ground circles near the Knight, 1.0 s warning each. Every telegraph >= 0.6 s (BossData.MinTelegraph).

rotting-colossus.title: The Rotting Colossus
rotting-colossus.attack: Phase 1: (a) double ground slam, two shockwave rings; (b) corpse boulder throw, lobbed, landing circle r 2.5 m, leaves a rubble obstacle 8 s; (c) grab: 1.2 s reach lane, a hit pulls the Knight in and deals 20 %. Phase 2: (d) roar summons 4 Frenzied Ghouls; (e) 3 boulders in a row. Slowest boss, biggest body.

bone-matriarch.title: The Bone Matriarch
bone-matriarch.attack: Floats, never melee. (a) homing skull orbs, 3 at a time, slow turn rate; (b) ring of 24 teal orbs with 3 gaps; (c) summon 3 Bone Archers. Phase 2: (d) cross beams, 4 rotating lanes (line telegraphs) for 4 s; (e) teleport to a random arena point every 8 s. Low HP, hard to reach.

ashgrave-butcher.title: The Butcher of Ashgrave
ashgrave-butcher.attack: Phase 1: (a) cleaver chop, long lane 6 m x 1.6 m; (b) charge dash (reuse KAN-61 charge) with a 1 s stun on a pillar hit; (c) cleaver spin, 2.5 s whirl that follows the Knight slowly (r 3 m). Phase 2: (d) chain hook throw, lane 10 m, pulls the Knight 4 m; (e) triple charge. Uses the existing BossFight slam / fan / charge code most directly: good first boss to port.
